resources.string: Practice, save a checkpoint, evaluate it, then decide whether to adopt it.
Practice runs use local disposable environments. They do not change the active living-world brain until you explicitly adopt a passing candidate.
This is the policy currently used by the living world. Training candidates stay separate until an evaluation and an explicit adoption.
A saved practice checkpoint is a candidate only. Evaluate this saved candidate before choosing Adopt or Keep current.
No saved candidate yet. Start practice, then save a checkpoint to make one available for evaluation.
Level 0 validates the environment contract only; it does not update policy weights.
Level 1 is the default trainable starting point.
Saved checkpoints remain training artifacts until you explicitly adopt a candidate.
The trainer is loading its saved state. No progress is shown until a real snapshot is available.
The saved candidate is being compared on holdout environments. Actions stay disabled until the completed comparison is available.
